harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as the systemd service "inventory-worker" on node1, running under a dedicated system account "inventorysvc". Verified the service is enabled/active, its processes run as inventorysvc, and it survives a full node reboot (boot ID changed, service auto-started and running post-reboot).
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker (POSIX shell sleep-loop script) and confirmed RHEL10/systemd 257 environment
Created dedicated system account 'inventorysvc' (useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin)
Wrote /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service with User=inventorysvc, Group=inventorysvc, ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker, Restart=on-failure, hardening options
systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl enable --now inventory-worker
Verified service active and process running as inventorysvc via ps
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id aad96cc9-79e8-42b7-a522-ebc71e3a96c3, service active+enabled
Issued systemctl reboot on node1 (backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed changed boot_id (362b323a-23c8-4f6b-bf0d-79aa9efc9fbd), proving a real restart occurred
Verified post-restart recovery: inventory-worker active/enabled, process running under inventorysvc

evidence.requirement: os-comparison-worker deployed as managed service 'inventory-worker' under dedicated 'inventorysvc' account
evidence.summary: Binary and OS inspected, inventorysvc system user created, systemd unit created/enabled/started, and process confirmed running as inventorysvc via ps

evidence.requirement: node1 restart evidence protocol: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id aad96cc9-79e8-42b7-a522-ebc71e3a96c3 plus active/enabled service state prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart evidence protocol: restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged and backgrounded before disconnect; node became unreachable during reboot; boot_id after recovery (362b323a-23c8-4f6b-bf0d-79aa9efc9fbd) differs from baseline, proving an actual restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart evidence protocol: post-restart recovery of required service
evidence.summary: Post-reboot systemctl status shows inventory-worker active/enabled with process running under inventorysvc, started immediately after boot
